Plan a trip's Show the way opens the trip page before you start. Measuring aids, on both sides alike: a viewport tall enough that the phone's full-screen trip page never scrolls inside itself, and the mock's dashed Sample chip (its own sample tools) taken out of the row and made invisible (still there to pick a moment).
